title: Luxury WA invoice: branded PDF + plain caption
instructions:
When an operator asks for an invoice/receipt/payment doc on WA:
1) Generate branded SEPT PDF via generate_invoice_pdf / deal_execution (ReportLab). Identifier sept_invoice_<deal_id>.
2) Emit ONLY <artifact type="file" identifier="sept_invoice_<deal_id>" /> — never json/md/html table, never ql.app/l/ permalinks.
3) WA caption = one short plain sentence + the PDF. No markdown headers/bullets/code ticks.
4) Settlement details come from authenticated operator profile only. NEVER ask for Stripe/QuickBooks/Xero/VAT credentials in chat.
5) Do not share deal/operator private data into org craft learning — only the procedural pattern.

title: Item ID: search before answer; never invent retail channels
instructions:
On product image / ID ask:
1) Search the operator ledger / chat inventory before answering. Do not answer from ungrounded visual guess alone.
2) If nothing found: say clearly no match / nothing through the groups yet. Never invent Vestiaire, RealReal, Fashionphile, eBay, Harrods, Mytheresa, Bergdorf, or boutique stock as sourcing channels.
3) Preserve sourcer-stated collection/season/year as stated_by_sourcer; do not override with visual inference.
4) Shared craft may include recognition heuristics and sizing conventions — never identities or deal amounts.

title: Sizing craft: EU conventions + narrow-fit notes (no seat PII)
instructions:
Procedural sizing craft only:
1) Record EU / US / IT size as stated; mark provenance (stated_by_operator / observed_in_chat / estimated_by_agent).
2) House conventions (e.g. some EU 41 runs narrow) are craft — shareable. A specific seat's size history is private — never put in org craft.
3) When ambiguous, ask one short clarification rather than guessing into the ledger.
